metadata.description: Skills and commands for Claude Code and other AI coding agents

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Three-mode planning system — always-active disposition, explicit blueprint generation (/blueprint), and blueprint execution.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Push and session commands — conventional commits and session logging.

plugins.name: rust-guide
plugins.description: Opinionated Rust style guide — makes AI-written Rust code look like a human wrote it.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Delegate research, code review, or collaborative multi-turn sparring to Codex CLI. Auto-selects the cheapest model for research and the best available for review and xhigh back-and-forth with Claude.

plugins.name: glm
plugins.description: Legacy explicit-only delegation instructions for GLM, a sunset model that ran headless inside Claude Code. Never auto-routes frontend or other work.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Rigorous code refactoring — every line earns its place. Preserves functionality, removes everything that doesn't justify its existence.

plugins.name: parallel
plugins.description: Launch and track parallel work in isolated git worktrees. Prevents duplicate work, tracks active branches.

plugins.name: clog
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to search your Claude Code chat history via the `clog` CLI. Auto-invokes for past-session lookups.

plugins.name: tech-stack
plugins.description: The canonical, opinionated tech stack for new projects — TanStack web, Rust backends, Railway-first, self-hosted data. Always active when scaffolding or choosing technology.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: How systems get laid out. One app by default, siloed apps/* when there are real deployables, named triggers for adding anything. The architect's judgment, encoded, so the person building never has to make a structure decision.

plugins.name: fable
plugins.description: Get the most out of Claude Fable 5 — Fable architects, cheaper models execute. Fable holds an opinion and defends it, gets on the same page with you first, then delegates execution to Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, or GPT-5.6 Sol via headless codex. Covers model routing, reasoning effort, and how to brief a worker. Always on via a SessionStart hook that injects it into every session.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Turn "this needs to be done" into a terse GitHub issue on any repo. The title carries the todo, the body exists only when the title can't.

plugins.name: plainspeak
plugins.description: Conversational style. Kill AI reply patterns. No filler openers, hedge stacks, recap closers, sycophancy, formatting theater, or jargon. One strong line first, depth on request. Always on via a SessionStart hook that injects it into every session.

plugins.name: noahspeak
plugins.description: Register-matching layer on top of plainspeak — talks back to Noah the way Noah talks. Short, lowercase-casual, verdict-first. Derived from ~3,200 real prompts. Always on via a SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: token-efficiency
plugins.description: Cut daily token burn in Claude Code. Always-on discipline (subagents for tool loops, bulk in files, /clear suggestions at task pivots) via a SessionStart hook, plus an invocable skill explaining where input tokens actually go and the levers ranked by impact.
